title: More Foods
description: This mod adds many kinds of foods.They are very useful and interesting!
body: This mod enriches the Minecraft world by adding a wide variety of new and interesting food items that you can craft, collect, and consume during your adventures. Among these delicious new options are special treats like ice apples and fresh mangoes, each with unique and useful effects. When you eat them, you will not only satisfy your in-game hunger but also gain special buffs, including good luck bonuses and powerful potion effects that can help you explore, fight, and survive more easily. All these foods are designed to be safe and balanced, so you can use them freely without worrying about any negative impacts on your gameplay experience. With this mod, you can bring the wonderful flavors of real-life fruits and dishes into your Minecraft world, making your survival journey more enjoyable, colorful, and full of fun surprises every time you try a new food.
